snippet.title: Borderlands 4 - Bounty Pack 4: Murders and Acquisitions - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Help Levaine settle the score between feuding factions and secure some powerful Order tech in the process in this all-new repeatable mission for Borderlands 4. Along with a colorful cast of unconventional Rippers, you'll have to contend with legions of bandits who are even more berserk than usual after having licked copious amounts of contaminated salt.

Both Bounty Pack 4: Murders and Acquisitions and Bounty Pack 4: Vault Card 4 will launch on July 30. Just like with Bounty Pack 3, we're releasing the DLC in two distinct parts that you can purchase individually. This means that when Bounty Pack 4 launches on July 30, you'll have the option to buy just the cosmetics, just the new narrative content, or both as a bundle if you're playing on Steam.

Bounty Pack 4: Murders and Acquisitions includes:
• New Main Boss (+3 Mini Bosses)
• New Legendary & Pearlescent Loot
• New Mission & Map Area

Bounty Pack 4: Vault Card 4 includes:
• 4 re-rollable pieces of Legendary gear
• 1 Unique Head for each base game Vault Hunter
• 4 Vault Hunter Skins usable by all Vault Hunters
• 5 Weapon Skins
• 5 Vehicle Skins
• 4 ECHO-4 Drone Skins
• 2 ECHO-4 Attachments

Buy Borderlands 4 Deluxe Edition: https://2kgam.es/4u28clK
Learn more here: https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/news/bounty-pack-4-story-pack-2-news/

*Bounty Pack 4 DLC has two parts: a repeatable mission in Murders and Acquisitions, and rewards earned through gameplay with Vault Card 4. This content is included with the Borderlands 4 Bounty Pack Bundle, Borderlands 4 Deluxe and Super Deluxe Editions, and is also available for separate purchase. Base game required. 

--------------------------------------------

Borderlands 4 is a mayhem-fueled looter shooter, jam-packed with billions of weapons, outrageous enemies, and intense co-op action. Explore a dangerous hidden planet Kairos as one of four new badass Vault Hunters.

Break free from the oppressive Timekeeper, a ruthless dictator who dominates the masses from on high. Now, a world-altering catastrophe threatens his perfect Order, unleashing mayhem across the planet. Ignite a resistance and blast your way through mechanical monstrosities, bloodthirsty bandits, and vicious beasts, with new traversal mechanics like: double jumping, gliding, dodging, fixed-point grappling, and more.

Fight solo or in co-op with up to three other players in this immense sci-fi adventure, packed with free-form combat and exploration, pulse-pounding boss fights, infinitely varied loot drops, and an eclectic cast of unforgettable characters new and old.
